detail.longDescription: A teeny-weeny bookmarklet update: I have rolled the 1-Click De-Crapulator into the Element Inspector tool. I often found I would use Element Inspector, and then immediately fire up the De-crapulator. So, merging the two seemed the logical thing to do: 👉 https:// a11y-tools.com/bookmarklets/#e lementinspector The 1-Click De-crapulator is still available as a standalone tool: https:// a11y-tools.com/bookmarklets/#o ne-click-decrapulator # a11y # accessibility # tooling # tools # webdev
